proc_p: Wardrobes take four to six weeks to make once you approve the design, and we agree the fitting day with you.
steps: We measure the wall and ask what you need to hang, fold and store, so the inside is planned before the doors.
You see the doors and the interior in 3D, with a quote that lists every rail, drawer and shelf.
Carcasses, doors and fillers are cut to your room in our workshop, so the wardrobe runs wall to wall.
We scribe it to your walls and ceiling and fit the handles before we leave. It’s covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Book a visit or send us a photo of the wall on WhatsApp. We’ll measure up, plan the inside around what you own and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote.
